title: monomyth law artifact
description: A build-time-synthesized, human-reviewed structural law artifact (ADR-0016). Tier `system`: an uncopyrightable idea/taxonomy, ship-safe, no source prose reproduced.

title.description: Human-readable title of the law artifact.

license.description: Licensing note for this artifact's content (idea/taxonomy only, no reproduced prose).

namespace.description: Shippability namespace. Laws are always ship-safe.

tier.description: Licensing tier. Laws are always the uncopyrightable system tier.

domain.description: The corpus domain this law belongs to (e.g. myth, folklore, esoterica).

tier_note.description: Human-readable note explaining why this artifact is ship-safe at tier `system`.

synthesis.description: Provenance of the build-time synthesis step that produced this law (ADR-0016).

reference_source_ids.description: Ids of `reference`-namespace corpus/manifest.json sources this law was synthesized from.

model.description: The model (or '(authored)') that produced the synthesis candidate.

generated.description: Date the synthesis candidate was generated (ISO 8601 date).

reviewed_by.description: The human reviewer who approved this law before commit. Mandatory and non-empty.

candidate_sha256.description: Optional checksum of the pre-review synthesis candidate, for audit trail.

count.description: Number of items; must equal items.length.

id.description: Stable 1-based item id, contiguous within the artifact.
